schedule:
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2: Basic Concepts in RF Design and Wireless Standards
Week 3: Challenge of Power Amplifier (PA)
Week 4: Holiday
Week 5: Power Amplifier Circuits for UEs
Week 6: Transmitter (Tx)
Week 7: GaN PAs for 5G BS Transmitter Systems
Week 8: Holiday
Week 9: Simulation Software
Week 10: Holiday
Week 11: Experiment: Load-Pull test theory and data processing
Week 12: Experiment: GAN model design & training / data completing, performance analysis, & optimization
Week 13: Experiment: PA output power sensing and impedance correction
Week 14: Project I: PA circuit design and measurement
Week 15-17: Project II: Oscillator theory, design, simulation, and implementation
Week 18: Project II: Oscillator circuit measurement
